question: What can the current external Fusion and ABC records support without claiming generic native-history or B-Rep-to-sequence recovery?

kernel_operation: ABC STEP input probe and fixed-box sandbox control
brep_observables: Fusion Line3D frame evidence in a frozen selector scope
preconditions: existing frozen mapping or sandbox policy
unsupported_conditions: external data admission to runtime or training

dependencies: Fusion selector conclusions depend on the frozen Line3D scope
ABC control conclusions depend on the fixed-box scaffold and existing geometry gates

observable_signals: Fusion strict replay volume/topology failure on a source-specific Line3D case
ABC fixed-box geometry-gate failure despite readable input and successful script exit
failure_and_repair.safe_action: Keep the source-specific review boundary and record the result as validation or robustness evidence only; do not infer an operation sequence, helper, or repair rule.
stop_conditions: a claim beyond the recorded source representation
any proposal to expose external raw assets or ignored traces to runtime
counterexamples: The ABC scaffold controls do not identify feature semantics.
The restricted Fusion Line3D result does not establish general native-history replay.

runtime_projection.review_trigger: External-source-specific evidence cannot be projected until a separately reviewed mechanism meets ADR-0016 and M19 evidence requirements.
